sources.name: University of Calgary Events Calendar
sources.notes: LiveWhale Calendar (same platform as Mount Royal's events.mtroyal.ca) - confirmed live 2026-08-26, ical export at /live/ical/events/upcoming works with no probing needed. 575 raw events across the 3-month window - this is the entire campus calendar (fitness classes, faculty talks, club meetings), not an international-student-specific feed, but it DOES carry International Student Services' own postings directly (confirmed 'Fall 2026 International Student Orientation Series: Working in Canada as an International Student' in the raw feed). ISS's own /student-services/iss/events page is a client-rendered widget with no feed of its own (Drupal, no JSON:API route found - tried ?_format=json, got 406), so this campus-wide ical is the only way to reach ISS programming. Relies on keyword/title scoring to surface the relevant events out of the noise - revisit if a repeating non-international programme dominates the practical stream (same pattern as Queen's in Kingston).

sources.name: Mount Royal University Events Calendar
sources.notes: LiveWhale Calendar - confirmed live 2026-08-26, same ical pattern as UCalgary. Also a whole-campus calendar (not international-student-specific); MRU's own International Education office posts an 'International Student Eat & Greet' etc via SAMRU (the student association) rather than this central calendar, so coverage of MRU-specific international programming may be thin - keyword scoring does the filtering. Revisit if noise dominates.

sources.name: Immigrant Services Calgary
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress) - confirmed live 2026-08-26. Site sits behind Cloudflare and 403s a bare request; needs a full Chrome-style User-Agent + 'Accept: application/json' header to pass the challenge (same trap as CultureLink in Toronto, just a stricter version). Settlement/employment workshops for newcomers - strong practical fit.

sources.name: Calgary Catholic Immigration Society (CCIS)
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress) - confirmed reachable 2026-08-26 (200, valid tribe JSON shape) but returned 0 events on the query window - largest immigrant-serving org in the Prairies (450+ staff, 20+ Calgary locations) so this is very likely a content gap (they don't currently publish dated public events to this calendar) rather than an access gap. Left enabled so it picks up automatically once they post.

sources.name: Calgary Public Library
sources.notes: NOT Communico/libnet (that only worked for Hamilton/Kingston) - Calgary Public Library runs on BiblioCommons (calgary.bibliocommons.com), a different platform entirely with its own client-rendered event widget and a /v2/events endpoint that returns an HTML app shell, not bare JSON. No parser exists for BiblioCommons kind yet - would be worth adding centrally since many large-city Canadian libraries (Toronto, Vancouver, Edmonton, Winnipeg) also run BiblioCommons. Registered probe pending that.

sources.name: SAIT International Centre - Events & Webinars
sources.notes: SAIT runs its own in-house CMS (not WordPress/Squarespace) - /events?format=json and /wp-json probes both fell through to the normal HTML page, no JSON/ical route found on a first pass 2026-08-26. Content is real (webinars on immigration, study/work permits) but only as static page text - re-probe or hand-enter specific dated sessions when announced.

sources.name: Bow Valley College
sources.notes: Site runs on Webflow - confirmed 2026-08-26 (data-wf-site markers, no /events?format=json or wp-json route, both are Webflow's normal HTML page). Runs LINC classes and the Directions for Immigrants in Trades and Professional Careers program for newcomers, and is a partner exhibitor at Newcomer Fair Canada (see manual_events) - no dated public event feed found.

sources.name: Centre for Newcomers
sources.notes: Wix site (confirmed 2026-08-26, ?format=json just returns the normal page) - supports over 50,000 newcomers/year. Runs a standing monthly info session (first Wednesday of each month: settlement services, PR card renewal, government benefits) with no dated feed - per the no-recurring-events rule, left with an empty manual event list until someone wants to hand-stamp specific first-Wednesday dates.

sources.name: Explore Downtown YYC (Downtown Calgary events)
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress) - confirmed live 2026-08-26. Found by following the wp-json/tribe links embedded in the City of Calgary's own 'Experience Downtown' page (calgary.ca/major-projects/experience-downtown/monthly-events.html), which turns out to be powered by this separate WordPress site. Free downtown programming (Surge City Hoops, markets, monthly events) - good central/transit-reachable social fit.

sources.name: Newcomer Fair Canada - Calgary
sources.notes: One-stop newcomer/immigration/employment fair - immigration consultants, employers, settlement services. Confirmed date via Eventbrite + careerfaircanada.ca 2026-08-26. Bow Valley College and other settlement orgs are exhibitors.

sources.name: Beakerhead
sources.notes: Annual arts/science/engineering festival across various downtown and TELUS Spark venues, returning in 2026 after a 2025 pause. Multi-day, free public installations - strong social fit for meeting people. Exact daily hours not published far in advance.

sources.name: GlobalFest (Calgary's International Fireworks Festival)
sources.notes: International themed-night festival with fireworks/drone shows at Spruce Meadows, ticketed (not free) but a strong culturally-relevant social pick for international students. 2026 dates Aug 27-30, themed nights per country.

sources.name: Rockpointe Church
sources.notes: 3851 54 Ave NE - runs free drop-in English Classes Wed/Thu evenings, per the ESL Cooperative Ministries directory. Standing weekly program, no dated feed - left empty per the no-recurring-events rule.

sources.name: Bow Valley Christian Church - ESL Ministry
sources.notes: 5300 53 Ave NW - LINC classes, ESL classes, conversation circles, and ESL Bible studies (online and in-person), per the ESL Cooperative Ministries directory. No dated feed - left empty per the no-recurring-events rule.
